articles.headline: No. 3 Louisville women use 26-0 run to ease past Alaska Anchorage 113-40 in Great Alaska Shootout
articles.description: — Elif Istanbulluoglu scored 19 points, Imari Berry had 13 of her 16 in the first quarter, and No. 3 Louisville used a big third-quarter run to ease past Alaska Anchorage 113-40 on Saturday night in the Great Alaska Shootout.

articles.headline: NCAA to scrap pregame handshakes at women's tourney after Auriemma-Staley spat
articles.description: The NCAA will encourage but no longer mandate pregame handshakes between head coaches at the women's tournament after last season's controversy involving Geno Auriemma and Dawn Staley.

articles.headline: Iowa State to begin 'enhanced monitoring' of Bill Fennelly, women's hoops team
articles.description: Iowa State addressed recent allegations of "verbal" and "emotional" abuse against head coach Bill Fennelly and said it will institute "enhanced monitoring" of the women's basketball team.

articles.headline: Harpring scores 20, No. 24 North Carolina women pull away from Alabama
articles.description: — Kate Harpring scored 20 points, Achol Akot added 16 and No. 24 North Carolina used two runs in the second half on Saturday to defeat Alabama 78-64 at the WBCA Showcase.
